title: アオハル杯4戦目・強豪チーム、撃破！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We overcome our previously undefeated rival, winning round four of the Unity Cup. Rice Shower is eager to keep up the momentum and seize victory again in our next bout.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon and Bitter Glasse, however, won't make it easy. After seeing our progress, they're determined not to let us beat them.
